definition.interpretation: Cross-sectional indicator, not confirmed chronic diagnosis
definition.missing_labs: Unknown and excluded; never false or zero
definition.population: Adults age 18+ excluding known pregnancy, with complete defining labs
definition.pregnancy: RIDEXPRG=1 excluded; codes 2/3 and missing/not-applicable retained
definition.primary: Race-free CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m2 OR UACR >=30 mg/g
sensitivity: eGFR <60 only on common complete-case domain
UACR >=30 mg/g only on common complete-case domain
definition.uacr_source: Official NHANES URDACT albumin creatinine ratio (mg/g)

primary_egfr_or_albuminuria.source_population: NHANES 2017-2018 MEC-exam-weighted U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized adults excluding known pregnant participants
primary_egfr_or_albuminuria.variance_method: Taylor linearization for a stratified PSU ratio

sensitivity_albuminuria_only.source_population: NHANES 2017-2018 MEC-exam-weighted U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized adults excluding known pregnant participants
sensitivity_albuminuria_only.variance_method: Taylor linearization for a stratified PSU ratio

sensitivity_egfr_only.source_population: NHANES 2017-2018 MEC-exam-weighted U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized adults excluding known pregnant participants
sensitivity_egfr_only.variance_method: Taylor linearization for a stratified PSU ratio

finding: Among complete cases, weighted cross-sectional CKD-indicator prevalence was 13.9% (95% CI 12.5%–15.3%; n=5,016) in NHANES 2017-2018 MEC-exam-weighted U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized adults excluding known pregnant participants.
limitations: One cross-sectional survey cycle cannot confirm chronicity or support diagnosis.
A single serum creatinine and spot UACR are subject to biological and measurement variability.
The complete-case estimate excludes eligible adults missing either defining laboratory measure and may differ if their prevalence differs.
Estimates describe the documented survey population and should not be interpreted as individual risk.
result_scope: NHANES 2017-2018 MEC-exam-weighted U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized adults excluding known pregnant participants

survey_method.confidence_interval: 95% Student-t using PSU-minus-strata design degrees of freedom, bounded to [0,1]
survey_method.domain_handling: Full valid MEC-exam design retained; adult participants excluding known pregnancy form the domain; all definitions use the common complete-case subset
survey_method.variance: Taylor linearization for a stratified PSU ratio

waterfall.stage: MEC examined with valid design and positive weight
complete eGFR and UACR defining labs
